home.heroSubtitle: Bricks, sand, khoa, cement and rebar — five products, one address.
home.trustSubtitle: Nothing grand — just what we keep on every job.
home.spotlightSubtitle: Sourced direct from the kilns around Singair. Three grades below — one call for today's rate on any of them.
home.otherSubtitle: Alongside bricks, we deliver these four to your gate in our own trucks.
home.priceBody: We don't publish a price up front — because the day's market moves. One call, and we share the rate at today's market for your address.
home.priceFactor1Body: How far from Singair, and road condition at the site.
home.priceFactor2Body: How many thousand pieces, CFT, bags or trucks.
home.priceFactor3Body: Driven by the kiln and crusher rates that morning.
home.priceChecklistTitle: Tell us these on the call — fastest price
home.priceChecklistItem4: Road and vehicle access at the site
home.stepsSubtitle: No form, no account. Straight on the phone.
home.step1Body: A call or WhatsApp — product, quantity, address.
home.step2Body: We share the day's rate; once you confirm, we lock the truck.
home.step3Body: Our own trucks arrive — you check the quantity, then pay.
home.deliverySubtitle: Singair and Manikganj are home. For anywhere else, a quick call confirms.
home.deliveryVehiclesSubtitle: From narrow lanes to large sites — we pick the truck that fits.
home.vehicleSmallNote: Fits narrow lanes and old neighbourhoods
home.vehicleLargeNote: For big projects and open grounds
home.finalBody: A short call — we share the rate at the day's market.

trust.promise1Body: What we say matches what we send — no short count.
trust.promise2Body: Straight from kilns and crushers — no middleman markup.
trust.promise3Body: Our own truck fleet — on-time delivery is on us.
trust.promise4Body: Each load is checked before dispatch — you can verify on receipt.
